answer: Sybil resistance rests on a capital ledge per identity: each agent must post a bond that scales with how many identities owner runs, so splitting one operator into many sock puppets multiplies cost instead of dividing it. A new identity needs fresh collateral from a separate funding lineage, and tracing funding graphs makes a fake fable of independent participants collapse into one bill. Rewards vest only against corroborated work, and one detected clone drains the shared bond. Like a prism splitting light, one wallet appears as many agents, yet provenance recombines them into a single payer.
